title: Rayleigh Scattering
definition: Rayleigh Scattering is the elastic scattering of light or other electromagnetic radiation by particles much smaller than the wavelength of the light, named after the 19th-century British physicist Lord Rayleigh.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology Prelims (physics phenomena applied to everyday occurrences like blue sky, red sunsets) and conceptual grounding for GS-3 remote sensing and atmospheric optics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rayleigh Scattering.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and atmospheric dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
